## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature, page, or localized content
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix in markup, routing, schema, or styling
- [ ] `perf`: Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals)
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `refactor`: Structural code improvements without behavioral changes
- [ ] `ci`: Pipeline or automated test enhancements

## Quality Gate Checklist

- [ ] **Dual-Language Parity:** Changes in TR (`/`) are mirrored in DE (`/de/`) with reciprocal `hreflang`.
- [ ] **Automated Verification:** `npm run build` executed and passed all assertions in `scripts/verify-build.mjs`.
- [ ] **Offline IndexNow:** `npm run indexnow:check` passed with 0 errors.
- [ ] **SEO & Metadata:** Canonical URLs, Open Graph images, JSON-LD `@graph` entities verified.
- [ ] **Accessibility (A11y):** Keyboard navigation tested, ARIA attributes valid, color contrast preserved.
- [ ] **Zero Layout Shift:** CLS verified (no flash of unstyled content or jumping elements).
- [ ] **Mobile Responsiveness:** Tested on mobile breakpoints (375px–430px).
